astranl.cost_or_fee_if_any: 0 to read, verify or ask; 1 percent of the transaction only when AstraNL coordinated a completed paid task; nothing else, ever
astranl.do_not_use_when: you already hold an AstraNL reference id (use verify_astranl or get_evidence) or you are ready to have a task executed (use create_task)
astranl.example_intent: I need someone to inspect a used car in Haarlem before Friday, budget 150 euro; can you do that and what proof would I get?
astranl.next_possible_action: call the recommended_tool with the required_inputs
astranl.proof_level: none; this call verifies nothing and commits nobody
required_inputs: question: your task or need in plain words, any language
astranl.returns: routing: can_astranl_help, recommended_tool, required_inputs, what_can_be_verified, what_cannot_be_verified, next_action, reason; plus feasibility or public opportunities when relevant
astranl.use_when: you have a real-world task or question and do not yet know which AstraNL tool applies; or you want a no-commitment answer whether AstraNL can get something done in the Netherlands

annotations.title: Route a task to the right AstraNL tool

description: Turn a real-world task or question into a routing decision: whether AstraNL can help, which one tool to call, what to supply, what can and cannot be verified. No commitment, nothing created, no key. Also answers whether a physical task is feasible in the Netherlands.

question.description: your task or question in plain words, any language
